svg.title: KTX from Seoul Station and SRT from Suseo Station to Busan Route Map
svg.desc: Two lines: KTX departs Seoul Station (teal) and SRT departs Suseo Station (coral), merging at Cheonan-Asan onto the Gyeongbu High-Speed Line through Daejeon, Dongdaegu, Gyeongju (formerly Singyeongju), and Ulsan to Busan. KTX Seoul to Busan takes as little as 2 hr 18 min with 74 departures daily (multi-stop trains take up to 3 hr 27 min; check Korail's website for fares). SRT Suseo to Busan takes as little as 2 hr 11 min with 44 departures daily, costing ₩52,200 in Standard Class and ₩75,700 in First Class effective September 1, 2026. SRT Standard-Class fares from Suseo listed below: Cheonan-Asan ₩11,300, Daejeon ₩20,100, Dongdaegu ₩37,000, Gyeongju ₩42,400, Ulsan ₩46,400, and Busan ₩52,200. Between Busan and Gyeongju, KTX takes 28 to 37 minutes and SRT Standard Class costs ₩10,100. Fastest rides to Gyeongju take 1 hr 59 min by KTX from Seoul and 1 hr 52 min by SRT from Suseo. Note: SRT tickets are not sold at Seoul Station, KTX does not serve Suseo Station, and the KORAIL PASS is not valid on SRT.
